final:
def stamp(ts: int) -> str:
    """Format a Unix timestamp in seconds as zero-padded UTC HH:MM:SS (24 hours)."""
    pre ts >= 0
    post out.char_count() == 8
    ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
    ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
    ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
    ex stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
    secs = ts % 86400
    h = secs // 3600
    m = (secs % 3600) // 60
    s = secs % 60
    hs = str(h)
    ms = str(m)
    ss = str(s)
    if h < 10:
        hs = "0" + hs
    if m < 10:
        ms = "0" + ms
    if s < 10:
        ss = "0" + ss
    return hs + ":" + ms + ":" + ss
